prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical "Good Morning Shenzhen" daily city-poster infographic combining a real photograph with editorial typography.
Canvas: Portrait poster, full-bleed photo background with text overlays and a right-side dark sidebar.
Layout: Top-left large headline; top-right small poetic blurb; bottom-left quote card plus weather strip; right edge vertical black sidebar with date and itinerary list.
Subject details: A modern glass-and-steel metro station interior (escalators, hanging wayfinding signs reading "Shenzhen", "Line 1") on the right half, opening onto a bright dawn view of the Shenzhen skyline across the bay on the left, with the sun low over the water. Several commuters walk along an elevated glass-railed skywalk; one man in the foreground wears glasses, earbuds, a backpack, and looks at his phone. Greenery hangs from the ceiling structure.
Visual style: Cinematic morning light, teal-and-lime color grade, clean sans-serif Chinese/English mixed typography, high contrast between the luminous sky and the dark sidebar.
Text content: Preserve Chinese labels exactly as shown — big lime headline 「早安深圳」 with English "GOOD MORNING SHENZHEN" and subtitle "CONNECTED AT DAWN"; top-right block 「在这座 / 永远在线的城市 / 每一个清晨 / 都有新的连接」 with English "A BRIGHTER SHENZHEN / A MORE CONNECTED TOMORROW"; bottom-left card "TODAY QUOTE 今日金句" with 「新的一天，不必等风，先把自己接通。」; weather strip 「天气 WEATHER 晴间多云 24–30°C 南风 3级」 and 「日出 06:20 城市信号 明亮」; right sidebar date "10 / 23 FRI 2025 OCT 23 FRI" followed by five bulleted stops: 「南头古城 NANTOU ANCIENT TOWN 08:00 历史与新生在此相遇」「福田 FUTIAN 09:30 城市心跳高效运转」「深圳湾 SHENZHEN BAY 12:00 海风照见更大的未来」「华侨城 OCT 15:30 艺术让城市更温柔」「海上世界 SEA WORLD 19:00 灯光与海不止于此」; sidebar footer "PEOPLE TECHNOLOGY CITY BAY TOGETHER SHENZHEN".
Constraints: Keep all listed text verbatim including Chinese characters, maintain the exact number of sidebar stops (five), no watermark.
